```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)
library(viridisLite)

# Generate reproducible synthetic business data
set.seed(42)
dates <- seq(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-31"), by = "day")
regions <- c("North America", "Europe", "Asia-Pacific", "Latin America")
categories <- c("Electronics", "Furniture", "Office Supplies", "Software")
segments <- c("Consumer", "Corporate", "Small Business")

df <- expand.grid(
  Date = dates,
  Region = regions,
  Category = categories
) %>%
  mutate(
    Sales = round(runif(n(), 100, 2500) + as.numeric(format(Date, "%m")) * 50, 2),
    Quantity = sample(1:20, n(), replace = TRUE),
    Profit = round(Sales * runif(n(), 0.1, 0.35), 2),
    Customer_Segment = sample(segments, n(), replace = TRUE)
  )

total_revenue <- sum(df$Sales)
total_orders <- nrow(df)
avg_profit_margin <- mean(df$Profit / df$Sales) * 100
total_profit <- sum(df$Profit)
```

# Overview

## Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Revenue"
#| icon: dollar-sign
#| color: primary
list(
  value = paste0("$", comma(round(total_revenue)))
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Profit"
#| icon: graph-up-arrow
#| color: success
list(
  value = paste0("$", comma(round(total_profit)))
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average Profit Margin"
#| icon: percent
#| color: info
list(
  value = paste0(round(avg_profit_margin, 1), "%")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Transactions"
#| icon: cart-check
#| color: warning
list(
  value = comma(total_orders)
)
```

## Row {height=40%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Monthly Revenue Trend by Region"
monthly_sales <- df %>%
  mutate(Month = format(Date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
  group_by(Month, Region) %>%
  summarize(Revenue = sum(Sales), .groups = 'drop')

p1 <- ggplot(monthly_sales, aes(x = Month, y = Revenue, color = Region, group = Region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Revenue ($)")

ggplotly(p1)
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue Share by Product Category"
cat_sales <- df %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarize(Revenue = sum(Sales), .groups = 'drop')

p2 <- plot_ly(cat_sales, labels = ~Category, values = ~Revenue, type = 'pie',
              textposition = 'inside', textinfo = 'label+percent',
              marker = list(colors = c('#2b5c8f', '#4682b4', '#6baed6', '#9ecae1'))) %>%
  layout(showlegend = TRUE)

p2
```

## Row {height=35%}

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Profitability by Customer Segment"
segment_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Customer_Segment) %>%
  summarize(
    Sales = sum(Sales),
    Profit = sum(Profit),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

p3 <- ggplot(segment_summary, aes(x = Customer_Segment, y = Profit, fill = Customer_Segment)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = "Customer Segment", y = "Profit ($)")

ggplotly(p3)
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Sales vs Profit Relationship"
p4 <- ggplot(df %>% sample_n(500), aes(x = Sales, y = Profit, color = Category)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkgray", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = "Sales ($)", y = "Profit ($)")

ggplotly(p4)
```

# Detailed Data

## Row {height=100%}

```{r}
#| title: "Interactive Business Data Explorer"
datatable(
  df %>% select(Date, Region, Category, Customer_Segment, Quantity, Sales, Profit) %>% head(300),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    dom = 'Bfrtip'
  ),
  filter = 'top',
  rownames = FALSE
) %>%
  formatCurrency(c('Sales', 'Profit'), "$")
```
